name: Hariom Pandey
headline: Software engineer building backend systems, developer tools, and full-stack products.
intro: I design APIs, queues, and sandboxes, and the interfaces on top of them. Koder, my online judge, runs untrusted code in locked-down Docker containers; my open-source work is read-only file access with path-containment checks.
availability: Open to software engineering and full-stack roles.
